description: This is a test class for the HeaderBasedPlaceholderSubstitutionAlgorithm in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.concierge.enforcement.placeholders package. It contains unit tests verifying placeholder substitution logic, immutability, and exception handling scenarios.

classes.name: HeaderBasedPlaceholderSubstitutionAlgorithmTest
classes.description: Unit tests for HeaderBasedPlaceholderSubstitutionAlgorithm, testing placeholder substitution, exception handling, and immutability.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by initializing the substitution algorithms with sample placeholder mappings.

methods.name: substituteFailsWithNullInput
methods.description: Tests that substituting null input throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: substituteFailsWithNullHeaders
methods.description: Tests that substituting with null DittoHeaders throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: substituteFailsWithNullWithDittoHeaders
methods.description: Tests that substituting with null WithDittoHeaders throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: substituteReturnsInputWhenInputDoesNotContainReplacers
methods.description: Ensures that input strings without placeholders are returned unchanged.

methods.name: substituteReturnsReplacedWhenInputContainsPlaceholder
methods.description: Checks that placeholders like '{{ my:arbitrary:replacer1 }}' are replaced correctly.

methods.name: substituteReturnsReplacedWhenInputContainsLegacyPlaceholder
methods.description: Checks legacy placeholder '${request.subjectId}' is replaced correctly.

methods.name: substituteThrowsUnknownPlaceholderExceptionWhenInputContainsUnknownPlaceholder
methods.description: Verifies that an exception is thrown when an unknown placeholder is encountered.

methods.name: partialPlaceholdersRemain
methods.description: Checks that incomplete placeholders '{{' are left as-is during substitution.

methods.name: unknownLegacyPlaceholderThrowsException
methods.description: Verifies that unknown legacy placeholders throw an exception.

methods.name: inputContainsNestedLegacyPlaceholderThrowsException
methods.description: Verifies that nested legacy placeholders '${...}' throw an exception.

methods.name: assertUnknownPlaceholderExceptionIsThrown
methods.description: Helper method to assert specific exception details for unknown placeholders.

methods.name: assertUnresolvedPlaceholdersRemainExceptionIsThrown
methods.description: Helper method to verify unresolvable placeholders produce the correct exception.

methods.name: assertGatewayPlaceholderNotResolvableExceptionIsThrown
methods.description: Verifies exception details for unresolvable placeholders.
